about: Pasternack Tilker Ziegler Walsh Stanton & Romano L.L.P. works from eleven offices across New York City, Long Island and Westchester, including Manhattan, the Bronx, Brooklyn, Forest Hills, Garden City, White Plains and Brentwood.

Its published practice spans workers' compensation, Social Security Disability, and construction-accident and personal injury claims. The firm publishes a contingency fee page, a consultation at no charge and a 24-hour intake line, in English and Spanish.
